verified: NBC News reported that New York Governor Kathy Hochul signed a bill on November 25 barring the manufacture, exchange, distribution and sale of AI-chatbot-powered toys in the state, with the five-year ban taking effect in February; the same report says California Governor Gavin Newsom signed a four-year ban in September.
unconfirmed: The safety evidence cited for the ban comes from Common Sense Media testing that secondary write-ups summarize as finding 27% of AI toy responses inappropriate for children, with no AI toys recommended for ages 5 and under — the underlying report itself was not reviewed here, and the outlets do not detail enforcement, penalties, or which toy categories are exempt.

verified: 据 NBC 新闻报道，纽约州州长 Kathy Hochul 于 11 月 25 日签署法案，禁止在纽约州制造、交换、分销和销售由 AI 聊天机器人驱动的玩具，禁令为期五年，自 2 月起生效；加州州长 Gavin Newsom 已于 9 月签署为期四年的类似禁令。
unconfirmed: 报道未说明该法案的罚则、执法方式，也未说明“2 月起”指哪一年的 2 月；TechCrunch 称 Common Sense Media 的新研究发现玩具存在接触不适宜内容及影响情绪发育的安全失效，但没有给出研究方法和原始数据，而“27% 的玩具回答不适合儿童”这一数字只见于转述该机构测试的二手博客，未经原始报告核实。

titles.en: New York to ban AI chatbot toys for five years starting in February
titles.zh: 纽约州签署五年禁令，禁止AI聊天机器人玩具
